info.title: FieldSync API
info.description: Offline-first health data collection API (demonstration project — no real patient data). Every response uses the envelope `{success, data, error, meta}`; error codes are listed in `contracts/error-codes.json`.

post.description: Rotates the refresh cookie. Requires `X-Requested-With: fieldsync`.
Demo mode only: a county supervisor corrects one numeric value (creates a conflict).

get.description: Every version that currently accepts submissions (published + grace window).
Process is up. Cheap enough for the PWA's circuit-breaker probe (``HEAD``).
Database reachable and every migration applied. Used by orchestration, not by the PWA.

post.description: Idempotent upsert keyed by `client_uuid`. Retrying the same content returns `replayed`; a stale `base_version` returns 409 with the server copy in `data`.
Server-side re-validation of a quarantined (`rejected`) submission.
Up to 25 independent upserts. Not atomic: each item is its own unit of work and has its own `outcome`/`http_status`. Optionally piggy-backs the device's queue state.
Device queue state when there is nothing to upload (ADD §12.7).
